financings_after_balance_sheet.what: At-the-market sales of 593,000 shares via Maxim, June 3-6, 2025 (gross proceeds; net not given)
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: Between June 3, 2025 and June 6, 2025, we sold 593,000 shares of our common stock for gross proceeds of $3,642,564 pursuant to an equity distribution agreement with Maxim in an “at-the-market” offering.

warrants.quote: warrants to purchase up to 5,150 shares of Common Stock, which is equal to 5.0 % of the aggregate amount of shares of Common Stock issued in the offering, at an exercise price of $ 145.75 per share
